description: Copy this to profiles/<name>.local.json and customize it for a specific academic job search.

discovery_strategy.purpose: Offer this as an optional high-recall audit. When the user asks for a broad discovery pass, search with broad terms, compare returned titles/institutions against focused search results, and add recurring useful vocabulary to the profile.
broad_result_review_rules: Keep broad-pass roles when the title, department, field tags, or institution context clearly match the profile.
Treat broad postdoc/researcher results from general science boards as false positives when they only match the rank bucket and have no field signal.
When multiple broad-pass results share useful wording, add that wording to search_terms or subfields before the next focused search.
